title: Figure 13. Error Suppression with the PTM Method; Figure 14. OTM/PTM/LTM growth simulation
description: Figure 13 shows (a) a DNA tile structure with labeled "Outputs," "Inputs," "14 nt," "11 nt," and "Protection strand," and (b–c) step sequences of tiles attaching in "Matched" and "Mismatched" configurations. Figure 14 shows three simulated Sierpinski-pattern growth fronts above a yellow diagonal seed, with τ values of about 1.52, 0.54, and 0.54. Captions read "Figure 13. Error Suppression with the PTM Method" and "Figure 14. Simulation results of growth in (A) the OTM, (B) the PTM, and (C) the LTM."
